title: voltmod gamedata.jsonc (version 2)
description: Where the engine keeps things. C++ owns every ABI (prototypes, vtable signatures, field types) in VoltMod::Bindings; this file only says where to look. Fragile: re-verify after every CS2 engine update.

version.description: Format version. VoltMod refuses anything else.

game.description: Game these entries were verified against.

verified.description: Date the whole file was last walked entry by entry (YYYY-MM-DD).

signatures.description: Byte patterns scanned in a loaded module; the match address is the binding.

addresses.description: Pointers reached through a rel32 displacement inside a matched signature.

vtables.description: Virtual function table slots, with the class whose table the index is counted in.

offsets.description: Byte offsets into layouts the SDK headers do not declare.

library.description: Module to look in, without platform prefix/suffix ("server" -> server.dll / libserver.so).

pattern.description: Space-separated hex bytes; "?" or "??" is a wildcard byte.

signature.description: Key in "signatures" whose match this address is derived from.

rel32At.description: Byte distance from the match to the 4-byte little-endian rel32 displacement.

class.description: Top-level RTTI/ELF class name owning the table (no namespace, no template).

max.description: Largest plausible offset for this field; a larger value is a typo, not a field.

align.description: Alignment the field the framework reads there requires.
